# Getting Help

Thanks for using Open Clipper! If you need help, here are your options:

## Documentation

- Check our [README](../README.md) for setup and build instructions
- Visit [grepcut.com](https://grepcut.com/) for the product

## Issues

- **Bug reports**: Use the bug report template
- **Feature requests**: Use the feature request template
- **Questions**: Open a GitHub issue or ask on [Discord](https://discord.gg/2uXgrUpe)

## Community

- Follow us on [X](https://x.com/GrepCut)
- Join our [Discord](https://discord.gg/2uXgrUpe)
- Follow the [Code of Conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md)

## Response Times

- Issues are typically triaged within a few business days
- Feature requests may take longer to evaluate
- Security issues are handled with priority

We appreciate your patience and contributions to making Open Clipper better!
